defects: Uses `AddMonoidAlgebra R M` instead of `MonoidAlgebra R M`; gold's `R[M]` notation is opened under the `MonoidAlgebra` namespace, so it denotes the monoid algebra (multiplicative monoid M), not the additive-monoid algebra construction used in the produced statement

Adds an extraneous `[Monoid M]` hypothesis on the index type M that is absent from gold and not needed (the Finsupp/additive structure of the algebra domain doesn't depend on any algebraic structure of M), unnecessarily restricting the statement's generality
Requires `[AddMonoid A]` on the codomain instead of the weaker `[AddZeroClass N]` used in gold, an unnecessary strengthening since `→+` only needs AddZeroClass on both ends
